description: Use whenever the user asks "will this voice-over fit in 30 seconds?", "is my reel script too long?", "what should I cut?", or wants a video script turned into a timed shot list. Do not eyeball it - beat_board.py times every beat at 150 wpm speech and 180 wpm reading, refuses a script that does not fit and says exactly how many words to cut.
